# Anselmi Media Downloader

> Free online tool to download videos, photos, reels and galleries from public X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram and Reddit posts. No account required.

## Main site
- https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/
- https://social-media.anselmidev.com/es/
- https://social-media.anselmidev.com/fr/
- https://social-media.anselmidev.com/de/
- https://social-media.anselmidev.com/pt/

## Platform pages
- X / Twitter: https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/x-twitter-video-downloader
- TikTok (no watermark): https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/tiktok-video-downloader
- Instagram (Reels, photos, stories): https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/instagram-downloader
- Reddit (videos, GIFs, galleries): https://social-media.anselmidev.com/en/reddit-video-downloader

## Notes
- Only public posts are supported.
- Media is fetched from platform CDNs; this site does not host copyrighted files.
- Available languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese.
